flows:
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:4173/ then Open Hati with no saved data (clear this site's browser storage and reload if any bills or people exist).
Add the people Ana, Ben and Cy.
Click Add bill and enter the name Internet with amount 500.00, choosing Ana, Ben and Cy.
Choose the percentage split and enter 50 for Ana, 30 for Ben and 30 for Cy.
Try to save the bill and read the message shown.
Assert The message "Percentages must add up to 100" is shown.
Assert The Internet bill does not appear in the bill list.
Store The error message text shown after trying to save the bill as {{percentage_error}}.

summary:
Opened Hati with a cleared starting state.
Added Ana, Ben, and Cy as people.
Created an Internet bill for 500.00 and selected all three people.
Chose a percentage split and entered 50% for Ana, 30% for Ben, and 30% for Cy.
Tried to save the bill; Hati showed “Percentages must add up to 100,” and the Internet bill was not added to the bill list.
